about: Anaesthesia machine modelled as a generic product: castors with brakes, base, cabinet with three drawers, worktop with rail, tower with flowmeter panel, flow tubes and O2/N2O/Air knobs, backbar with sevoflurane and desflurane vaporisers, absorber canister, bellows housing, APL valve, circuit ports, top shelf, monitor with traces, reserve cylinders with yoke. Water and gases via the nested service point (FMC_P_MechEq_ServicePoint); Medical Equipment cannot hold pipe connectors. Reference: query: machine anaesthesia medical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=machine+anaesthesia+medical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
